verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no network-level control that stops preview or other non-production deployments from reaching production services. Per-environment variables (vercel-docs-23) only let teams keep separate configuration and credentials per environment. Deployment Protection (vercel-docs-26) governs who can open deployment URLs, which is inbound access, not outbound isolation. Both are adjacent features rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can isolate non-production environments from accessing production services
